subject: general
question: Where was the All India Khilafat conference held in 1919?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The All India Khilafat Conference was held in **Delhi** in 1919.
 
• The Khilafat Movement was launched to protest against the harsh treatment meted out to the Caliph of Turkey by the British after World War I.
 
• It was one of the major movements that aimed at uniting the Indian Muslims to protect their religious leader, the Caliph.
 
• Several prominent leaders, including Mahatma Gandhi, supported the Khilafat Movement to strengthen the Indian struggle for independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The movement was led by prominent leaders such as Maulana Mohammad Ali, Maulana Shaukat Ali, and Abul Kalam Azad.
 
• Despite its initial success in mobilizing mass support, the movement gradually declined after the abolition of the Caliphate in Turkey in 1924.
 
• The Khilafat Movement played a crucial role in shaping the political landscape of India and the eventual path to independence.
